scientific_integrity: The result gives a complete symbolic classification; reproducibility checks are finite and do not replace the proof. Historical novelty is supported by primary-text comparisons but not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Only finite-poset incidence algebras over fields.
The zero coproduct is included for linear-space/rank enumeration but is not a nonzero Frobenius structure.
2013 theorem comparison is to the literal no-monomial-relations wording; narrower implicit conventions are not excluded.
Finite computational checks cover n <= 5 over F_2 and F_3 only.
title: All nearly Frobenius coproducts on finite-poset incidence algebras
